default.notes: Whatever single device adb reports. platformVersion is deliberately unset so Appium auto-detects it -- pinning a version here would make the profile fail on any other emulator.

pixel7_api36.notes: Newer API level. No systemPort/mjpegServerPort/chromedriverPort here on purpose -- DevicePool derives all three from the calling thread, so adding a profile never risks a port collision with an existing one.

pixel7_api34.notes: Older API level, deliberately version-distinct from pixel7_api36 so a parallel run is real fragmentation evidence rather than the same image twice.
